🏆 V COLA FIRST LUCKY WINNER RECEIVES HIS TV PRIZE! 🎉

Excitement continues in the WIN WITH V COLA national consumer promotion as Edson Chirombo, one of the campaign’s first lucky winners, has officially collected his brand-new LED television!

Edson entered the competition after purchasing V Cola from Chipiku Clocktower in Blantyre and was announced as the TV winner during the campaign’s first lucky draw held on 13 October 2026.

The promotion, organised by Nutrinova Food and Beverages, the official distributor of V Super Soda in Malawi, gives customers across the country the opportunity to win exciting prizes, including a MK5 million grand prize, MK2 million second prize, MK1 million third prize, televisions and smartphones.

To participate, customers simply purchase 5 V Cola drinks in one transaction, scan the promotional QR code, submit their details and upload a photo of their receipt. Original receipts must be retained for prize verification.

🥤 The winning continues!

💰 MK5 MILLION GRAND PRIZE STILL UP FOR GRABS!

Follow @V7malawi for campaign updates and upcoming draws.

Terms and conditions apply.

## **Keto Chocolate Chip Cookies**

Ingredients (about 18 cookies)

2 cups almond flour (super fine)

¼ cup coconut flour

½ tsp baking soda

¼ tsp salt

½ cup unsalted butter (softened)

½ cup erythritol or monk fruit sweetener (granulated or brown-style)

1 large egg

1 tsp vanilla extract

½ cup sugar-free chocolate chips (Lily’s or ChocZero)

Instructions

Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Mix dry ingredients: In a bowl, combine almond flour, coconut flour, baking soda, and salt.

Cream butter & sweetener: In another bowl, beat butter and erythritol until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla, and mix well.

Combine: Slowly mix dry ingredients into wet until dough forms. Fold in chocolate chips.

Shape cookies: Scoop dough (about 1 tbsp each) onto baking sheet, leaving space between.

Bake: Bake 10–12 minutes until edges turn golden (centers will look soft, they’ll firm up as they cool).

Cool: Let cookies cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before moving to a rack.

Nutrition (per cookie, approx.)

Calories: 120

Protein: 3g

Fat: 11g

Net Carbs: 2g

Keto swaps I made:

Almond + coconut flour instead of all-purpose flour.

Erythritol/monk fruit instead of sugar.

Sugar-free chocolate chips instead of regular

items.postText:
A few months of building, tasting, testing, inking, printing, wrapping, shooting and occasionally overthinking. 

All to make one thing: a soda worth the fuss.

A peek at what went into bringing Super Soda to life…

1. boxes almost too nice to recycle
2. catching Helen Wouters, tattoo artist behind Apple Elderflower, where the magic happens
3. new display by the talented GramCnC (Super Soda is shelf-stable!)
4. one of Super Soda’s first outings in the wild at SuperNova 
5. getting the colours justtt right 
6. always better ice-cold; hence the new fridges
7. JASPER V. GESTEL (Ginger Lime legend) at work in his studio
8. taking the dragons for a drive
9. leaving our mark 🛹
10. making sure Super Soda looks as good as it tastes with FOODPHOTO 
11. hard not to feel inspired at JASPER V. GESTEL ‘s
12. another fridge… we did say they’re better cold

And somewhere between all of that, Super Soda became real. Give it a try!
